paper_title: Wideband Search for Axionlike Dark Matter Using Octupolar Nuclei in a Crystal
notes: Paper reports wideband exclusion limits on ALP-gluon coupling strength C_G/f_a spanning eight decades in ALP mass (1.3 µHz to 500 Hz oscillation frequency, corresponding to ~10^-20 to ~10^0 eV mass range). The coupling is constrained through oscillating parity-odd time-reversal-odd nuclear Schiff moment of 153Eu ions in a crystal. Data points extracted from Fig. 4 (blue shaded exclusion region). The experiment assumes local dark matter density ρ_DM = 0.4 GeV/cm³. A stochastic correction factor (up to ~3.9× for very light ALPs) has been applied to account for ALP field amplitude fluctuations. The paper explicitly states this is the most stringent atomic/molecular constraint in this mass range. Confidence level is 95% as stated in the paper. The coupling type is AxionCPV because the paper constrains CP-violating oscillations of the QCD θ-parameter induced by ALP-gluon coupling, which is a CP-odd nuclear force effect. | selector: text (sole candidate) | [CONVENTION REVIEW] declared coupling convention 'C_G/f_a in GeV^-1' is not canonical and has no vetted auto-conversion; needs human review
